spanish-louisiana ends 1801 (infobox date) although Spanish administration lasted to 30 Nov 1803 and 9-10 Mar 1804; french-louisiana (am-06-c) draws that interval as an occupation.
captaincy-general-of-chile runs to 1826 and colonial-brazil to 1822, beyond the Wikipedia infobox spans, to cover royalist Chiloe and the kingdom years.
